filters.play_by_play_participation_check: injured QB absent from passer/rusher IDs; listed replacement present
filters.minimum_prior_opportunities: Not available in current point-impact output; prior-game threshold used instead.
filters.actual_participation_verification: Require injured QB absent from passer/rusher IDs and listed replacement present in same-team game passer/rusher IDs; conservative proxy, not full snap verification.
filters.duplicate_qb1_out_rows: After PBP verification, collapse multiple eligible player rows to one team-game using median impact; row counts and IDs retained.

interpretation.expected_relationship: If the estimated absence impact is meaningful, larger positive impact should generally associate with more negative actual-minus-baseline team score residuals.
limitations: PBP verification uses passer/rusher participation, not every offensive snap; QBs with no recorded pass/rush event may be misclassified or excluded.
The listed replacement must record a passer/rusher action, but this does not establish that they played every QB snap or were the only replacement.
OUT report status and historical depth chart still do not prove public report timing or full-game absence.
Small eligible samples and nonrandom QB absences limit statistical power.
Controls are descriptive and not matched or randomized.
Correlation is association, not causal calibration; no point adjustment is approved.
